name: io.github.Nikhilprasad-r/redmine-mcp-connector
description: stdio MCP server wrapping the Redmine REST API: issues, projects, users, time, wiki, versions.

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Redmine instance, no trailing slash (e.g. https://redmine.example.com)

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Redmine API access key (My account -> Show API access key)

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: If true, blocks all mutating HTTP methods (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_ALLOW_RAW_REQUEST
environmentVariables.description: If true, registers the redmine_request escape-hatch tool for arbitrary REST paths

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_MAX_PAGES
environmentVariables.description: Max pages when using fetch_all on list tools

environmentVariables.name: REDMINE_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Cap for redmine_attachment_download, in bytes (default 5 MiB)
